evidence_quotes.quid_pro_quo: Rep says 'However in order for us to be, to have an on point estimate we might need to ask you a few questions that might take around ten to fifteen minutes. Are you free right now ma'am?' — time-boxed ask present, but no explicit promise of a 'dependable quote' and no clear wait for a yes before continuing into discovery.
evidence_quotes.discovery_basics: Name (Katie), moving date (October 24th Saturday), route (Tampa to Riverview), size (1,492 sq ft) all confirmed in Section 1.
evidence_quotes.their_agenda: Never asked. Rep moves directly into logistical probing ('How many bedrooms the house, please?') without first establishing their concerns or what they want answers to on the call.
evidence_quotes.logistics_details_gathered: Property type (house), stories (one story origin, two story destination), rooms (3 bedrooms origin, 5 bedrooms destination), garage (two-car, partial use), special items (grill, shelves, washer/dryer), walkthrough of each room (bedrooms, office, living room, dining room, kitchen) — all seven logistics categories covered.
evidence_quotes.packing_services_offered: Asked explicitly: 'Couple of packing ma'am would you need help packing or everything will be back once we get there?' Customer answered 'Anything will be passed' (inferred: no packing service needed).
evidence_quotes.box_count_asked: Not asked. Rep notes 'we're not going to be moving the entire house and just furniture' and mentions boxes customer will move themselves, but never asked for a typical box count or overflow check.
evidence_quotes.estimate_anchor: Anchor provided: 'typically ma'am a 1400 square foot house usually takes two movers between six to eight hours' and personalized: 'However in your case since we're not going to be moving the entire house and just furniture...estimating the move. To take only around four and a half, five and a half hours. So, it's good to budget and overall of $900 to $1,100.' Both present.
evidence_quotes.pricing_framing: Trip/overnight fees not explicitly disclosed upfront. 2.5-hour minimum, 15-minute increments, and 'not a guess' framing present: 'The time will only start as soon as we are on site and open the contract. And then you have us for as long as you need us for any move. It's a two and a half hour minimum. Once we go over the minimum the time will be prorated in fifteen minutes increment.' Also: 'this is just an estimate and we only factored in a little extra for time the quote based on the details so have gathered on move date itself. You only pay for the actual time used.'
evidence_quotes.feels_fair_then_silence: Not asked. Rep provides estimate ($900–$1,100) but never asks 'Does that feel fair?' or equivalent, and does not pause for customer reaction.
evidence_quotes.on_time_guarantee_delivered: Fully delivered: 'We have a specific on time guarantee so once the movers arrive with or as if the movers arrive late, you automatically start to get discount on your final bill. The later they arrive, the picker your discount will be.'
evidence_quotes.damage_coverage_delivered: Fully delivered: 'you're also gonna get up to $2,000 free evaluation coverage. So, say for example, if anything gets damaged, gets, gets mishap during the move, you don't have to worry, you can give us a call to file a claim for it. It's gonna be for zero deductible and we're either gonna repair, replace or reimburse that within three to five business days.' Coverage, no-deductible framing, and built-in status all present.
evidence_quotes.closes_the_loop: No loop-closing question asked. Rep does not ask a version of 'Does that put those to rest?' after delivering the Two Promises.
evidence_quotes.final_concerns_check: Asked as throwaway: 'Before we go over pricing structure and estimate, do you have any questions any clarification regarding the moving process in general?' This is a generic 'any questions?' rather than a genuine 'What's still concerning you about this move?' Customer does raise a real concern ('how they move things, like, do they protect them or do they just load it up onto the truck?'), rep answers, but the initial ask was not the genuine version.
evidence_quotes.catch_all_asked: Not asked. No version of 'Anything coming with you we haven't talked about?' appears in the transcript.
evidence_quotes.explicit_ask: Full: 'Would you want our help with this move so I can book you in for no deposit required?' Asked plainly without a built-in out.
evidence_quotes.rate_lock_mentioned: Not mentioned. No explicit rate-lock or price-hold statement made.
evidence_quotes.booking_confirmed: None. Customer defers ('I would like to talk to my husband about it first and give you a callback if that's okay?'), and rep accepts without confirming any booking details — no date confirmation, phone number, arrival window, crew size, addresses, or notes for crew about concerns.

top_strength: Arden gathered logistics comprehensively via detailed room-by-room walkthrough and delivered both major promises (On-Time Guarantee and No Worries Damage Coverage) with full transparency and no-deductible clarity.
coaching_note: Ask 'What are your biggest concerns about this move, and what do you want answers to on this call?' before diving into logistics probing, and close the estimate with a pause-and-listen 'Does that feel fair?' — both are load-bearing moves to build trust and confirm buy-in.
